trial_court: Court of learned Additional District Judge, Sundernagar, District Mandi, H.P.
case_name: Sanjay Kumar Gangania v. Rita Sharma
facts_of_case: Proceedings under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act were filed before the Court of learned Civil Judge. The petition was dismissed. An appeal was preferred under Section 28 of the Hindu Marriage Act before the learned District Judge. An application was filed to return the appeal to be presented before the appropriate Appellate Court, which was rejected.

legal_principles.principle: An appeal against an order/judgment of a Court exercising delegated power shall be filed before the Court to which such decree would have been appealable if it were made by the original Court.
legal_principles.held: This Court is of the considered view that in light of the exercise of this delegated power, the appeal was to be filed against the order/judgment of the said Court before a Court ordinarily before which a decree passed by the learned District Judge was appealable.

legal_principles.principle: When a Court exercises delegated power, the appeal against its order/judgment shall be filed before the Court to which such decree would have been appealable if it were made by the original Court.
legal_principles.held: This Court is making this observation for the reason that the language of Section 28 of the Hindu Marriage Act is to the effect that all decrees made by the Court in any proceeding under the Hindu Marriage Act shall be appealable as decrees of the Court made in exercise of its original civil jurisdiction.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is set aside and the appeal is allowed.
